items.mainDefect: The cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock, so concurrent first requests redundantly read the manifest serially.

secondary.defect: The cache is overwritten even when the manifest read fails, potentially replacing valid cached assets with nil.

items.mainDefect: The cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock, so concurrent first callers each rebuild it.

secondary.defect: A failed load is assigned to the cache, potentially caching nil or partial results for later readers.
